terms_doc.intro: These terms apply to using the Metis Fit app. By using the app you accept them.
terms_doc.s1_text: The app connects members with gyms that use Metis Fit: membership, entry, bookings, workouts, food and messages to your trainer. Gym services (memberships, prices, rules) are provided by the gym itself.
terms_doc.s2_text: Your account is personal. Keep your password safe and do not share your entry QR code: it changes every minute and is valid only for you. Keep your profile details accurate.
terms_doc.s3_text: Prices, duration, pauses and cancellation rules are set by the gym, and you see them in the app before you buy or book. No-shows can temporarily limit bookings, according to the gym’s rules.
terms_doc.s4_text: Plans, calories and tips are for information and are not medical advice. Before starting training or changing your diet, especially with health conditions, talk to a doctor.
terms_doc.s5_text: Misusing the app, other people’s accounts or codes, and sending abusive messages to trainers and staff is not allowed. The gym may limit access for breaking the rules.
terms_doc.s6_text: We may change these terms; we announce larger changes in the app. For membership questions contact your gym; the contact is in Profile.

privacy_doc.intro: In short: we keep only what the app needs to work, we do not sell data, and you can download or delete all of your data.
privacy_doc.s1_text: Name, email, phone and profile photo; memberships, payments and visits; bookings and sessions; what you enter yourself: workouts, food, measurements, habits and messages to your trainer.
privacy_doc.s2_text: So you can enter the gym, book training and track progress; so the gym can manage memberships; and to send the notifications you turned on.
privacy_doc.s3_text: The gym sees what membership needs (membership, visits, bookings). A trainer sees your progress only if you allow it. Your food diary, habits and measurements are visible only to you.
privacy_doc.s4_text: The connection to the server is encrypted, each gym sees only its own members, and passwords and secret links are not stored in readable form.
privacy_doc.s5_text: When you scan a food barcode, the app asks the open Open Food Facts database for that barcode only, without your data. Push notifications go through Apple and Google services.
privacy_doc.s6_text: In Profile you can download all your data and delete your account. You turn notifications and their categories on and off yourself.
privacy_doc.s7_text: As long as you have an account. After you delete it, personal data is deleted, except what the gym must keep by law (for example invoices).
